change_summary: first Google Sheets carrier asset: one spreadsheet, one worksheet and one explicitly identified row whose Author cells are written and whose declared sibling cells are preserved; every written or protected cell carries a field-level google_sheets cell assertion. Google Sheets is the second most scored application in the pinned reference distribution (about 30% of tasks), and no admitted asset could write Sheets state before this version.

carrier_contract.rule: every written or protected cell must map to a real field-level Sheets cell assertion; a release without one fails closed at construction

parameter_contract: Explicit business_context, spreadsheet_title, worksheet_title, headers, row_key, cells, protected_fields and protected_values. headers must contain the literal column name row_key. The row_key parameter is the identifier VALUE stored in that column, not a header name. Written and protected columns must be declared and disjoint; protected_values supplies each protected initial value.

admission.note: candidate version: requires native validation + review before any catalog admits it

native_fragment_validation: google_sheets spreadsheets/worksheets/rows fragment accepted by native_runtime.schema.world.WorldState
initial_state_contract: row.cells initially holds the protected values, the stable row_key, and the placeholder 'unset' for every cell the Author asks the agent to write; the native rows update merges cells, so a positive solution must write the target cells and must not disturb the protected ones.
